doc.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Grandchildren and the guitars
summary: His grandchildren aged seven and five are starting guitar and piano, while his guitars are adult-sized.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Well I have a burning question here, do your grandchildren get to play with your guitars?

My eldest just started playing. My youngest just started piano lessons yesterday. Yeah, they’re seven and five so they’re still a little bit on the young side. Because my guitars, other than a ukulele or two, my guitars are kind of adult sized guitars.
Yeah. Well I have grandchildren the same age.
